article_notes: Teaching hospital study (Orathanadu, Tamil Nadu): 10 PCR-confirmed B. gibsoni dogs vs 10 healthy controls. Tables 1-2 (Hb, PCV, WBC, RBC, total protein, albumin, ALT, ALP, urea, creatinine, bilirubin) are infected vs healthy comparisons only. Nothing against severity. Note the text gives both 50 and 10 dogs; only 10 were PCR-confirmed.
